source: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor press release: Alpha and Omega Semiconductor Unveils AmpStack Packaging: A (07-07-2026)

players.product: smart power stages / DrMOS and MOSFETs for GPU VRMs; 800V HVDC devices

quarterly_data.signal: AOS introduced the AOPL66801 80V MOSFET in a half-bridge configuration in its DFN6x5 AmpStack package, which uses vertically stacked die technology (two MOSFETs connected as high-side and low-side, forming a half-bridge) with an optimized clip for the switch node and a Kelvin sense pin; the company says it increases power density and saves PCB space compared to a two DFN5x6 discrete MOSFET solution, for power conversion applications 'ranging from next-gen Megawatt AI factories to everyday power tools'. Specs: 80 V VDS, 2.2 mOhm max RDS(ON) at VGS = 10 V, ID 304 A (high side) and 215 A (low side), maximum junction temperature 175 C. The part 'is immediately available in production quantities, with a 16-week lead time', at a unit price of $6.16 in 1,000-piece quantities.
